verses.title: Verses
verses.text:
O My Lord! for the sake of Your Supreme Majesty,
Have mercy upon us all for the sake of Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ.
The captivity of worldly struggles has bound us tightly;
Release our hardships for the sake of Ali, the Remover of Difficulties.

I invoke the name of Khwaja Hasan al-Basri,
For the sake of Shaykh Abdul Wahid, one devoted to Allah.
Bestow Your grace upon us all through the blessings of Khwaja Ibn Ayaz
And Shah Ibrahim Balkhi, the king who renounced the world for You.

Have mercy for the sake of Hazrat Khwaja Huzaifa,
And Bu Habira Basri, the guide upon the path of truth.
For the sake of Khwaja Mamshad, fill our hearts with joy,
And for Shaykh Abu Ishaq, the Pole of the Chishti Order.

For the sake of Khwaja Abdal Ahmad Abu Muhammad, the exemplary guide,
And Khwaja Abu Yusuf, the master of purity.
For the sake of Khwaja Moudud, Khwaja Haji Sharif,
And Khwaja Usman, the leader of the righteous.

For the sake of the spiritual pole, the beloved of the morning, the master of masters,
Abdul Qadir al-Jilani, who manifests Your divine power.
Unique among creation, the radiant lamp of the Prophet ﷺ,
For the sake of the Family of the Five (Panjatan) and Muhyuddin, the Helper of mankind.

For the sake of the Saint of Hindustan, Khwaja Moinuddin Hasan Chishti,
And Shaykh Qutbuddin, the Pole of the Spiritual Guides.
Sweeten our affairs through the blessings of Khwaja Ganj-e-Shakar,
And Nizamuddin Auliya, the Beloved of the Saints.

Illuminate our hearts through the blessings of Shah Nasiruddin Chiragh,
And Kamaluddin, the perfection of the righteous.
Remove the darkness of this world through Sirajuddin,
And for the sake of the knowledge of Truth and the guidance of religion.

For the sake of Hazrat Mahmood Rajan, leader in this world and the next,
And Jamaluddin, the master of purity.
Through the blessings of Shaykh Hasan and Khwaja Shaykh Muhammad,
And Hazrat Yahya Madani, the exemplary guide.

Grant Your grace upon us through Shah Kalimullah Wali,
And Nizamuddin, the one accepted by Allah.
For the sake of the guide of both religion and worldly life, Pir Fakhruddin,
And Khwaja Nur Muhammad, our spiritual guide.

For the sake of Hazrat Khwaja Sulaiman, the helper of both worlds,
The refuge of those in need and the fulfiller of prayers.
For the sake of the Guide of Religion, the Beloved of the Lord of the Worlds,
And Khwaja Allah Bakhsh, the master of purity.

For the sake of Hafiz Musa, the guide of the helpless,
And Khwaja Hamid Miya, the man of purity.
Through the blessings of Khwaja Inayat, the comforter of the poor,
And Hazrat Shaykh-ul-Mashaikh, the exemplary master.

Keep us steadfast upon the paths of Shariah and Tariqah,
For the sake of Khwaja Haji Musharraf, the man of purity.
Honor us in both this world and the Hereafter, O Allah,
For the sake of Khwaja Mahboob, the Pole who manifests the Truth.

Immerse us completely in Your love, O Allah,
For the sake of our Master, our Guide, and our Spiritual Leader.
Grant us true love for them, and make us thirsty for the Truth,
For the sake of the Qadri, Chishti, and all the righteous saints (Awliya).

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.text:
In the name of the blessed souls

Through the blessings of the pure, sacred, sanctified, and radiant soul of the Leader of all the Prophets, the Proof of the Righteous, the greatest of all creation, the essence of the entire universe, the Seal of the Prophets, the Intercessor on the Day of Judgment, the Beloved of Allah, the Healer of the illness of sin, the spiritual direction of both worlds, the Ka'bah of this world and the Hereafter, the embodied Light—Hazrat Sayyiduna Ahmad al-Mujtaba Muhammad al-Mustafa, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ—and upon his family, his descendants, his wives, his progeny, the People of his Household (Ahl al-Bayt), his rightly guided successors, and all of them.

Through the blessed soul of the Gateway to Knowledge, the Imam of East and West, the Commander of the Believers, the Master of the Universe, Haider al-Karrar, the Lion of Allah, the Remover of Difficulties, the Conqueror of Khaybar, Abu Turab, the Caliph of the Muslims—Hazrat Sayyiduna Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah ennoble his countenance)—and upon his family, descendants, wives, progeny, Ahl al-Bayt, successors, and all of them.

Through the blessed soul of Imam of the Spiritual Way, Khwaja Hasan al-Basri (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Abdul Wahed bin Zahed (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Muhammad Fudayl ibn Iyad (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Sultan Ibrahim ibn Adham Balkhi (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Sadiduddin Abu Huzaifa Muraishi (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Aminuddin Abu Hubayrah Basri (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Mamshad Dinwari (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Abu Ishaq Shami, the Pole of the Chishti Order (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Abdal Ahmad Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Abu Muhammad Muqtada Zahid Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Abu Yusuf Nasiruddin Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Qutbuddin Moudud Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Haji Sharif Zindani Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Qutb al-Awliya, Burhan al-Asfiya, the Lamp of Faith, the Imam of the God-fearing, Khwaja Usman Harooni Chishti (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of the Deputy of the Messenger of Allah in Hindustan, the Sultan of Saints, Khwaja Gharib Nawaz, Hazrat Sayyiduna Moinuddin Hasan Chishti Sanjari Ajmeri (may Allah be pleased with him).

Through the blessed soul of Hazrat Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Hazrat Baba Fariduddin Ganj-e-Shakar Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Hazrat Sultan-ul-Mashaikh, Mahboob-e-Ilahi, Khwaja Nizamuddin Auliya Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Hazrat Nasiruddin Mahmood Chiragh-e-Delhi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Kamaluddin Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Sirajuddin Siraji Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Ilmuddin Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Mahmud Rajan Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Jamaluddin Jaman Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Shaikh Husain Muhammad Naquib Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Shaikh Muhammad Hussain Azam Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Yusuf Yahya, Qutb of Madinah Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Shah Kalimullah Wali Jahanabadi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Shah Nizamuddin Wali Aurangabadi Faridi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Maulana Fakhruddin Dehlavi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Nur Muhammad Maharoi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Maulana Shah Sulaiman Tausi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Allah Bakhsh Mia Saheb Tausi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Hafiz Musa Pir Alam Mia Saheb Tausi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Syed Hamid Mia Saheb Tausi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Diwan Syedna Inayat Hussain Ali Khan Moini Tausi Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Haji Syed Musharraf Ali Bukhari Chishti (may Allah have mercy on him).

Through the blessed soul of Khwaja Haji Mahboob Kassim Qadri Chishti Musharrafi (may Allah have mercy on him).

For the well-being, protection, and long life of Khwaja Haji Munawar Ali Mahboob Kassim Chishti (may Allah preserve him), we offer this humble supplication.

verses.title: Verses
verses.text:
Ya Ilahi Apne zaat-e-kibriya ke waaste Rehm kar hum sab par Muhammad Mustafa (S.A.W.) ke waste
Band mehnat ki asiri ne kiya hai sakht azad Khol de Mushkil Ali Muskil Khusha ke waaste

Khwaja Basri Hasan ka naam laata hoon Shafiq Shaikh Abdul Wahid Ahle Baka ke waaste
Fazl kar hum sab par Tufail-e-Khwaja Ibne Ayaz Shah Ibrahim Balkhi Badshah ke waaste

Hazrat Khwaja Huzaifa ke liye Tu Rehm kar Bu Habira Basri Sahibe Huda ke waaste
Khwaja Mamshad ke khaatir hum sab ka dilshaad kar Shaikh Bu Ishaq Kutbe Chishtiya ke waaste

Khwaja Abdal Ahmad Bu Muhammad Mukhtada Khwaja Bu Yusuf Sahibe Safa ke waaste
Khwaja Moudud Huq aur Khwaja Hajee Sharif Khwaja Osman Ahle Ikhtada ke waaste

Kutbe Rub Mehboob-e-Subha Pir-e-Pira Dastagir Abdul Qadir Qadire Kudrat Numa ke waaste
Khalq mein Lasaani hai Noor-e-Chirag-e-Mustafa Aale Panjatan Mohiuddin Ghous-ul-Wara ke waaste

Waaliye Hindustan Khwaja Molnuddin Hasan Shaikh Kutbuddin Kutbul Akhtiya ke waaste
Kaam kar Shirin tufaile Khwaja Ganj-e-Shakar Aur Nizamuddin Mehboob-e-Auliya ke waste

Dil ko raushan kar tufaile Shah-e-Nasiruddin Chirag Aur Kamaluddin Kamale Asfiya ke waste
Dur kar zulmat Siraj-ud-din duniya ke liye Aur Ilm – ul – haq wa - Din Ilm - ul Huda ke waste

Hazrat Mahmood Rajan Sarware Duniya wa Din Aur Jamaluddin Jaman Sahibe Safa ke waaste
Shaikh Hasan aur Khwaja Shaikh Muhammad ke tufail Hazrat Yahya Madni Muktada ke waaste

Fazal kar hum sab par tufaile Shah Kalimuliah Wali Aur Nizamuddin Maqbool-e-Allah ke waaste
Din wa duniya ka Wasilah Pir-e-Alam Fakr-e-din Khwaja Nur Muhammad Rehnuma ke waaste

Hazrat Khwaja Sulaiman Do Jahaan ke Dastagir Kibla-e-Hajaat Kaba Muddua ke waaste
Haadiye Din Nabi Mahboob-e-Rabbul Aalamin Khwaja Allabaksh Sahibe Ba Safa ke waaste

Hafiz Musa Pir-e-Alam bekason ke rehnuma Khwaja Hamid Miya Alhe Safa ke waaste
Waasta Khwaja Enayat ka jo hai Miski Nawaz Hazrat Shaikh-ul-Mashaik Muktada ke waaste

Rak Shariyat aur Tariqat pe hum sab ko saabit kadam Khwaja Hajee Musharraf Ba Safa ke waaste
Surkhru rakhna hum sab ko dono jahaan mein Ai Allah Khwaja Mahboob Kutbe Huq Numa ke waaste

Hum sab ko Apne ishq mein bekhud banaa de Ai Allah Mere Maula mere Rahbar Rahnuma ke waaste
De Hum sab Ko Unki Mohabbat Kar Haqi Ka Taashna Qadriya Chishtiya aur kul Auliya ke waaste

lineage.text:
